units: mm, assembly coordinates: X forward, Y left (thumb side), Z up
carrier_pcb: unchanged: experiments/30g-onepiece-test-shell/carrier-config.json (same Gerber, same firmware pin map)
trigger_switch: SS-01GL (straight hinge lever, solder lugs) — see evt1_trigger.py

shell.note: Outer surface follows the 30 g frame silhouette and its 33.6 mm thickness (Y -18..15.6) except: rear edge moved to X=-62.5 so the 52x82 carrier (X -60) is enclosed; upper front at X=19.5 for the front USB-C port; grip back curved in below the carrier (Z<-42).
shell.upper_zone_note: 0.8 mm wall above this polygon (not gripped); 1.0 mm in the grip and around the trigger

windows_xz.note: Windows sit where the right hand does not rest; the right-side window under the SuperMini also vents the TP4054 charger

vent_slots_right.note: TP4054 ventilation under the SuperMini; slots too narrow for a fingertip

supermini.orientation: rotated 180 deg about Y from the 30 g experiment: USB-C faces +X (front), ceramic antenna faces -X

usb_opening.note: USB-C spec maximum plug overmold 12.35 x 6.5 mm passes; receptacle mouth sits at the wall inner face

charge.boost_ma_nominal: ~280 if PR4=5.6k (seller: 300 mA); ~450 (heat-limited) if PR4=1.5k as the reference schematic label reads - measure
charge.recommendation: short BOOST after the first-sample temperature check (TP4054 PROG 10k -> 10k||5.6k)

supermini.placement_note: Board 5 mm further toward -Y than the 30 g layout so the antenna end (X -7.5) sits ~8 mm from the carrier GND pour (both copper layers are poured); drop-in along -Y, three left-shell posts hold it down

imu.name: GY-601N1 / LSM6DSV16X
imu.cradle: printed cradle under the GY edges; rests on two right-shell tabs under the top wall and one post at (4,10); clamps carrier hole H1; the left shell presses the GY onto it

battery.retention: rests on the right-shell floor (0.3 mm ribs); low side rails and end stops in the right shell; four left-shell pads hold it down
battery.note: moved 4.47 mm toward -Y from the 30 g experiment: it now lies on the shell floor, 5.5 mm below the carrier back face

battery_switch.type: mini slide switch, SS-12D00G4 class (1P2T, use COM + one throw)
battery_switch.position: rear wall, straddling the split; actuator through the rear wall at Z 24
battery_switch.wiring: J_SWITCH 1 (BAT_RAW) and J_SWITCH 2 (BAT_SW); measure the purchased part before fitting

joystick_cap.note: cap lowered 4.0 mm with the 15.6 face; the 20 deg cone keeps the same stop angle

right_cap.note: no outer lip: inserted from inside the left half; flange holds it out, D2FC bottoming ends travel
